invariants.rationale: Method always returns a new TableWriteStats object, cannot be null.
Input parameter writeMetadata is expected to be non-null for method to execute correctly.
Method chains getWriteStatuses() on writeMetadata; should not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
Each WriteStatus contributes one writeStat; sizes must match.

meta.value: one-to-one between write statuses and collected stats

invariants.rationale: Collected statistics in result should be non-null as each stat is derived from WriteStatus.getStat().
